description:
[PUBLISHES to social accounts · `publish` scope] Creates a rule that reshares (or comments on) every new post of the source accounts. Defaults to needs_approval: each fire waits for approve in act_on_publish_action. Only LinkedIn (native reshare) and X (quote own / retweet) really repost; other platforms get a link share. Confirm with the user first. Needs the `publish` scope (or admin) on the Agency plan or higher.
(Wraps POST /api/v2/automations/reshare-rules.)

approval.description: `needs_approval` (default): each fire waits for a person (POST …/actions/{id} `approve`). `auto`: runs on its own.

kind.description: `reshare`: share the post to `targets`. `comment`: comment on the post itself through the source account.

sourceAccountIds.description: Fires when a post goes live through any of these connected accounts.

template.description: The reshare commentary or comment text. Tokens, resolved only once the URL exists: `{{postUrl}}` (this post, on the comment's platform), `{{postUrl:<platform>}}`, `{{parentPostUrl:<post or draft id>}}` (another flayr post: same platform, else YouTube, else any), `{{youtubeUrl:<post or draft id>}}`.

name: create_share_rule
title: Create a share rule
